description: Search this host's own documentation and tool descriptions. Returns up to k hits (default 3, response under 2 KB), each with a snippet, the nearest runnable example and an anchor. Read-only, anonymous, no tenant data -- call it with the error text or import line you are stuck on before reading any docs file.

kind.description: Only search the page of this registered kind (docs/kinds/<kind>.md).

q.description: What you are stuck on: a tool name, an error code or message, an import line.

tenant_key.description: The key `signup` returned. Optional on the connection that ran signup (or host.redeem): that connection is already bound to the tenant it created, so later calls on it need no tenant_key. On a connection with no Authorization: Bearer header and no prior signup, omitting it implicitly signs that connection up as a brand-new tenant and runs this call as it -- see host.whoami's source field. When both a header and this argument are present, the header wins.

name: host.help.search
